queries.title: [0] DB Health Check
queries.content:
RETURN {
  GitCommit: LENGTH(GitCommit),
  RTL_Module: LENGTH(RTL_Module),
  DesignEpoch: LENGTH(DesignEpoch),
  DesignSituation: LENGTH(DesignSituation),
  Author: LENGTH(Author),
  AUTHORED: LENGTH(AUTHORED),
  MAINTAINS: LENGTH(MAINTAINS),
  RESOLVED_TO: LENGTH(RESOLVED_TO),
  CROSS_REPO_SIMILAR_TO: LENGTH(CROSS_REPO_SIMILAR_TO),
  CROSS_REPO_EVOLVED_FROM: LENGTH(CROSS_REPO_EVOLVED_FROM),
  OR1200_golden: LENGTH(OR1200_Golden_Entities),
  MOR1KX_golden: LENGTH(MOR1KX_Golden_Entities),
  IBEX_golden: LENGTH(IBEX_Golden_Entities),
  MAROCCHINO_golden: LENGTH(MAROCCHINO_Golden_Entities)
}
queries.description: Pre-demo sanity check. Expected: 3796 commits, 6404 modules, 381 epochs, 721 situations, 137 authors, 214 RESOLVED_TO, 72 cross-repo bridges.

queries.title: [1a] The Living Graph — Scope Overview
queries.content:
LET repos = (
  FOR c IN GitCommit
    COLLECT r = c.repo WITH COUNT INTO n
    RETURN {repo: r, commits: n}
)
RETURN {
  total_commits:    SUM(repos[*].commits),
  total_modules:    LENGTH(RTL_Module),
  total_epochs:     LENGTH(DesignEpoch),
  total_situations: LENGTH(DesignSituation),
  total_authors:    LENGTH(Author),
  semantic_bridges: LENGTH(RESOLVED_TO),
  cross_repo_links: LENGTH(CROSS_REPO_SIMILAR_TO),
  by_repo: repos
}
queries.description: Scene 1 opener. Shows the scope: 4 repos, 3796 commits, 6404 modules, 381 epochs, 137 authors, 214 semantic bridges spanning 30 years.

queries.title: [1b] Epoch Timeline — MOR1KX Milestones
queries.content:
FOR e IN DesignEpoch
  FILTER e.repo == "openrisc/mor1kx.git"
  FILTER e.epoch_type == "milestone_tag"
      OR e.epoch_type == "initial_commit"
  SORT e.start_ts ASC
  RETURN {
    epoch: e.label,
    git_tag: e.git_tag,
    date: DATE_FORMAT(e.start_ts * 1000, "%yyyy-%mm"),
    epoch_type: e.epoch_type
  }
queries.description: Scene 1. MOR1KX milestone timeline from initial commit (2012) through v5.2 (2024). Shows release cadence.

queries.title: [2a] Time Machine — OR1200 at GitHub Migration (2009)
queries.content:
LET target_ts = 1243238472
FOR m IN RTL_Module
  FILTER m.repo == "openrisc/or1200.git"
  FILTER m.valid_from_ts <= target_ts
  FILTER m.valid_to_ts > target_ts
  SORT m.label ASC
  RETURN {
    module: m.label,
    epoch:  m.design_epoch,
    file:   m.file
  }
queries.description: Scene 2. Point-in-time query: what 60 modules existed when OR1200 arrived on GitHub (May 2009).

queries.title: [2b] Time Machine — OR1200 Before/After rel3
queries.content:
LET before_ts = 1243238472
LET after_ts  = 1283211145

LET before = (FOR m IN RTL_Module FILTER m.repo == "openrisc/or1200.git"
  FILTER m.valid_from_ts <= before_ts AND m.valid_to_ts > before_ts
  RETURN m.label)

LET after = (FOR m IN RTL_Module FILTER m.repo == "openrisc/or1200.git"
  FILTER m.valid_from_ts <= after_ts AND m.valid_to_ts > after_ts
  RETURN m.label)

RETURN {
  modules_at_svn_migration: LENGTH(before),
  modules_after_rel3:        LENGTH(after),
  new_in_rel3:               MINUS(after, before),
  removed_in_rel3:           MINUS(before, after)
}
queries.description: Scene 2. Temporal diff: which modules were added/removed between SVN migration and rel3 release.

queries.title: [2c] Time Machine — Ibex Module Growth
queries.content:
FOR e IN DesignEpoch
  FILTER e.repo == "lowRISC/ibex.git"
  LET module_count = LENGTH(
    FOR m IN RTL_Module
      FILTER m.repo == "lowRISC/ibex.git"
      FILTER m.valid_from_ts <= (e.end_ts != null ? e.end_ts : 9999999999)
      FILTER m.valid_to_ts > e.start_ts
      RETURN 1
  )
  FILTER module_count > 0
  SORT e.start_ts ASC
  LIMIT 15
  RETURN {
    epoch:   SPLIT(e.label, " — ")[1],
    date:    DATE_FORMAT(e.start_ts * 1000, "%yyyy-%mm"),
    modules: module_count
  }
queries.description: Scene 2. Ibex growth curve: 14 modules in 2015 → 24+ over hundreds of epochs.

queries.title: [3a] Design Situations — Inventory
queries.content:
FOR s IN DesignSituation
  COLLECT class = s.situation_class, repo = s.repo WITH COUNT INTO n
  SORT repo, class
  RETURN {situation_class: class, repo: repo, count: n}
queries.description: Scene 3. What kinds of design situations exist across all repos?

queries.title: [3b] Design Situations — Major Refactor
queries.content:
FOR s IN DesignSituation
  FILTER s.repo == "lowRISC/ibex.git"
  FILTER s.situation_class == "major_refactor"
  SORT s.valid_from_ts ASC
  LIMIT 1
  LET affected_modules = (
    FOR m IN RTL_Module
      FILTER m.repo == s.repo
      FILTER m.design_epoch == s.epoch
      RETURN m.label
  )
  RETURN {
    situation:    s.label,
    epoch:        s.epoch,
    date_range:   DATE_FORMAT(s.valid_from_ts * 1000, "%yyyy-%mm-%dd"),
    tags:         s.tags,
    modules_in_epoch: LENGTH(affected_modules),
    sample_modules: affected_modules[0..4]
  }
queries.description: Scene 3. A dramatic refactor situation in Ibex — what changed and when.

queries.title: [3c] Design Situations — Release Preparations
queries.content:
FOR s IN DesignSituation
  FILTER s.situation_class == "release_prep"
  SORT s.valid_from_ts ASC
  RETURN {
    repo:    s.repo,
    release: s.epoch,
    date:    DATE_FORMAT(s.valid_from_ts * 1000, "%yyyy-%mm-%dd"),
    outcome: s.outcome,
    tags:    s.tags
  }
queries.description: Scene 3. Every release preparation moment — automatically derived from git tags.

queries.title: [4a] Cross-Repo — Structural Bridges
queries.content:
FOR e IN CROSS_REPO_SIMILAR_TO
  LET src = DOCUMENT(e._from)
  LET tgt = DOCUMENT(e._to)
  FILTER src != null AND tgt != null
  SORT e.similarity_score DESC
  RETURN {
    from_module: src.label,
    from_repo:   src.repo,
    to_module:   tgt.label,
    to_repo:     tgt.repo,
    score:       e.similarity_score,
    type:        e.similarity_type
  }
queries.description: Scene 4. Cross-repo structural DNA: modules like cpu, alu, ctrl appear across OR1200, MOR1KX, Ibex.

queries.title: [4b] Cross-Repo — Evolutionary Lineage
queries.content:
FOR e IN CROSS_REPO_EVOLVED_FROM
  LET src = DOCUMENT(e._from)
  LET tgt = DOCUMENT(e._to)
  RETURN {
    evolved:     src.repo,
    derived_from: tgt.repo,
    evidence:    e.lineage_type,
    score:       e.similarity_score
  }
queries.description: Scene 4. Architectural lineage: marocchino evolved from mor1kx.

queries.title: [5a] Déjà Vu — Fetch Module Situations
queries.content:
FOR s IN DesignSituation
  FILTER s.situation_class == "subsystem_addition"
  FILTER LENGTH(
    FOR t IN s.tags
      FILTER CONTAINS(LOWER(t), "fetch") OR CONTAINS(LOWER(t), "if_")
      RETURN 1
  ) > 0
  SORT s.valid_from_ts ASC
  RETURN {
    repo:    s.repo,
    epoch:   s.epoch,
    date:    DATE_FORMAT(s.valid_from_ts * 1000, "%yyyy-%mm-%dd"),
    modules: s.tags,
    outcome: s.outcome
  }
queries.description: Scene 5. The Déjà Vu Index: has anyone added a fetch module before? When and where?

queries.title: [T1] Module Time-Travel — MOR1KX Core Modules at Birth vs v5.1 (Graph View)
queries.content:
LET core_modules = ['mor1kx_dcache', 'mor1kx_icache', 'mor1kx_cpu', 'mor1kx_execute_alu', 'mor1kx_decode']
LET dates = [1327622400, 1641600000]

FOR T IN dates
  FOR label IN core_modules
    LET snap = FIRST(
      FOR m IN RTL_Module
        FILTER m.label == label AND m.repo == 'openrisc/mor1kx.git'
        FILTER m.valid_from_ts <= T AND m.valid_to_ts > T
        LIMIT 1 RETURN m
    )
    FILTER snap != null
    LET best_epoch = FIRST(
      FOR ep IN OUTBOUND snap BELONGS_TO_EPOCH
        SORT ABS(ep.start_ts - T) ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN ep
    )
    FILTER best_epoch != null
    FOR ep2, e, p IN 1..1 OUTBOUND snap BELONGS_TO_EPOCH
      FILTER ep2._id == best_epoch._id
      RETURN p
queries.description: Visualizer: 5 core MOR1KX modules (dcache, icache, cpu, alu, decode) at birth (2012) vs v5.1 (2022). Two epoch clusters with shared modules bridging 10 years.

queries.title: [T2] Design Snapshot — MOR1KX v5.1 Release (Graph View)
queries.content:

  RETURN p

queries.title: [T4] Evolutionary Lineage — OR1200 → MOR1KX (Graph View)
queries.content:
FOR p IN UNION(
  (
    FOR ev, edge, path IN 1..1 OUTBOUND
        'MOR1KX_Golden_Entities/MOR1KX_g_2ccb86b96f39'
        CROSS_REPO_EVOLVED_FROM
      RETURN path
  ),
  (
    FOR epoch IN DesignEpoch
      FILTER epoch.repo == 'openrisc/mor1kx.git'
        AND epoch.epoch_type IN ['initial_commit', 'milestone_tag']
      SORT epoch.start_ts ASC
      LIMIT 4
      LET snap = FIRST(
        FOR mod IN INBOUND epoch BELONGS_TO_EPOCH
          FILTER mod.label == 'mor1kx_cpu'
          SORT mod.valid_from_ts DESC
          LIMIT 1
          RETURN mod
      )
      FILTER snap != null
      FOR epoch2, e, path IN 1..1 OUTBOUND snap BELONGS_TO_EPOCH
        FILTER epoch2._id == epoch._id
        RETURN path
  )
)
RETURN p
queries.description: Visualizer: CROSS_REPO_EVOLVED_FROM bridge + mor1kx_cpu at birth and v1.0. Run → Graph tab.

  FILTER REGEX_REPLACE(p.edges[2]._id, '/.*', '') == 'CROSS_REPO_SIMILAR_TO'

LET T2 = 1378100000

FOR e IN BELONGS_TO_EPOCH
  FILTER e.role        == 'introduced_in'
    AND e.valid_from_ts >= T1
    AND e.valid_from_ts <= T2

queries.title: [TT-3] Time Travel — Module Births & Deaths (Graph View)
queries.content:
LET T1 = 1327622400
LET T2 = 1641600000

LET at_T1 = (FOR m IN RTL_Module
  FILTER m.repo == 'openrisc/mor1kx.git' AND m.valid_from_ts <= T1 AND m.valid_to_ts > T1
  RETURN DISTINCT m.label)

LET at_T2 = (FOR m IN RTL_Module
  FILTER m.repo == 'openrisc/mor1kx.git' AND m.valid_from_ts <= T2 AND m.valid_to_ts > T2
  RETURN DISTINCT m.label)

LET removed = MINUS(at_T1, at_T2)
LET born = MINUS(at_T2, at_T1)

FOR label IN UNION(removed, SLICE(born, 0, 10))
  LET snap = FIRST(
    FOR m IN RTL_Module
      FILTER m.label == label AND m.repo == 'openrisc/mor1kx.git'
      SORT m.valid_from_ts ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN m
  )
  FILTER snap != null
  LET epoch = FIRST(FOR e IN OUTBOUND snap BELONGS_TO_EPOCH LIMIT 1 RETURN e)
  FILTER epoch != null
  FOR ep2, e, p IN 1..1 OUTBOUND snap BELONGS_TO_EPOCH
    FILTER ep2._id == epoch._id
    RETURN p
queries.description: Visualizer: modules that were born or died between T1 and T2, connected to their introduction epochs. Default: MOR1KX birth → v5.1 (10 removed + 10 new = 20 paths).

    FOR m IN 1..1 OUTBOUND a MAINTAINS

      RETURN DISTINCT c.repo

  FILTER LENGTH(maintained) > 0
  SORT LENGTH(maintained) DESC

    modules_maintained: LENGTH(maintained),

queries.title: [DT2] Deep Traversal — Cross-Repo Subgraph (Graph View)

    ANY 'OR1200_Golden_Entities/OR1200_g_bd5d34270ec4'

queries.title: [Evolution] Module Temporal Sequence (Graph View — Query Editor)
queries.content:
LET module_name = "mor1kx_cpu"
LET module_repo = "openrisc/mor1kx.git"

LET snapshots = (
  FOR m IN RTL_Module
    FILTER m.label == module_name AND m.repo == module_repo
    COLLECT year = DATE_YEAR(m.valid_from_ts * 1000) INTO grp = m
    SORT year ASC
    LET representative = FIRST(
      FOR s IN grp SORT s.valid_from_ts ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN s
    )
    LET epoch = FIRST(
      FOR ep IN OUTBOUND representative BELONGS_TO_EPOCH
        SORT ABS(ep.start_ts - representative.valid_from_ts) ASC
        LIMIT 1 RETURN ep
    )
    LET epoch_edge = FIRST(
      FOR ep, e IN 1..1 OUTBOUND representative BELONGS_TO_EPOCH
        FILTER ep._id == epoch._id RETURN e
    )
    RETURN { snap: representative, epoch: epoch, epoch_edge: epoch_edge, year: year }
)

FOR i IN 0..LENGTH(snapshots)-2
  LET curr = snapshots[i]
  LET next = snapshots[i+1]
  LET days = ROUND((next.snap.valid_from_ts - curr.snap.valid_from_ts) / 86400)
  LET timeline_edge = {
    _key: CONCAT("ev_", curr.snap._key, "_", next.snap._key),
    _id: CONCAT("PRECEDES_EPOCH/ev_", curr.snap._key, "_", next.snap._key),
    _from: curr.snap._id,
    _to: next.snap._id,
    label: CONCAT(TO_STRING(days), " days"),
    type: "EVOLVED_TO",
    time_gap_days: days
  }
  LET verts = UNIQUE(APPEND(
    [curr.snap, next.snap],
    APPEND(
      curr.epoch != null ? [curr.epoch] : [],
      next.epoch != null ? [next.epoch] : []
    )
  ))
  LET edges = APPEND(
    [timeline_edge],
    APPEND(
      curr.epoch_edge != null ? [curr.epoch_edge] : [],
      next.epoch_edge != null ? [next.epoch_edge] : []
    )
  )
  RETURN { vertices: verts, edges: edges }
queries.description: Query Editor → Graph tab. Shows yearly snapshots of a module connected by virtual EVOLVED_TO edges, each linked to its epoch. Change line 1 to try: mor1kx_cpu (11yr, 6 authors), mor1kx_execute_alu (ALU core), mor1kx_dcache (cache), ibex_core (IBEX top-level).

actions.name: [GitCommit] Modules modified by this commit
actions.description: Show which RTL modules were modified by the selected commit.
actions.queryText: FOR node IN @nodes FOR v, e IN 1..1 OUTBOUND node MODIFIED RETURN e

actions.title: [RTL_Module] Time travel (epochs + commits)
actions.name: [RTL_Module] Time travel (epochs + commits)
actions.description: Show both the epochs and commits associated with a module — its full temporal context.
actions.queryText: FOR node IN @nodes FOR v, e IN 1..1 ANY node BELONGS_TO_EPOCH, MODIFIED RETURN e

actions.title: [RTL_Module] Deep traversal (4 hops, all edges)
actions.name: [RTL_Module] Deep traversal (4 hops, all edges)
actions.description: Explore up to 4 hops from a module across the entire graph. Use for discovery — may return large subgraphs.
actions.queryText: FOR node IN @nodes FOR v, e IN 1..4 ANY node GRAPH 'IC_Temporal_Knowledge_Graph' OPTIONS { uniqueVertices: 'path' } LIMIT 300 RETURN e

actions.title: [Chunks] Spec concept → cross-repo successors
actions.name: [Chunks] Spec concept → cross-repo successors
actions.description: From a spec chunk, traverse 3 hops to find cross-repo successors via entities and golden entities.
actions.queryText: FOR node IN @nodes FOR v, e IN 1..3 ANY node GRAPH 'IC_Temporal_Knowledge_Graph' OPTIONS { uniqueVertices: 'path' } LIMIT 100 RETURN e

actions.title: [RTL_Module] Show deep-RTL internals (temporal → HEAD)
actions.name: [RTL_Module] Show deep-RTL internals (temporal → HEAD)
actions.description: From a temporal module snapshot, follow SNAPSHOT_OF to the deep-RTL HEAD version and show its ports, signals, logic chunks, and parameters.
actions.queryText: FOR node IN @nodes FOR v, e IN 1..2 OUTBOUND node SNAPSHOT_OF, HAS_PORT, HAS_SIGNAL, CONTAINS, HAS_PARAMETER LIMIT 200 RETURN e

actions.title: [RTL_Module] Time travel — same module across years
actions.name: [RTL_Module] Time travel — same module across years
actions.description: From a module, find the same-named module at different years. Shows how it evolved over time. Each node is a yearly snapshot connected to its epoch.
actions.queryText:
FOR n IN @nodes
  LET nodeId = IS_STRING(n) ? n : n._id
  LET node = DOCUMENT(nodeId)
  FILTER node != null AND HAS(node, "label")
  FILTER STARTS_WITH(nodeId, "RTL_Module/")
  FOR other IN RTL_Module
    FILTER other.label == node.label AND other.repo == node.repo
    FILTER other._id != node._id
    COLLECT year = DATE_YEAR(other.valid_from_ts * 1000) INTO grp = other
    SORT year ASC
    LET representative = FIRST(grp)
    LET edge = FIRST(FOR ep, e IN 1..1 OUTBOUND representative BELONGS_TO_EPOCH RETURN e)
    FILTER edge != null
    RETURN edge

actions.title: [RTL_Module] Show contemporaries — what else was alive
actions.name: [RTL_Module] Show contemporaries — what else was alive
actions.description: From a module, find all other modules alive at the same moment in time. Shows the full design context at that snapshot.
actions.queryText:
FOR n IN @nodes
  LET nodeId = IS_STRING(n) ? n : n._id
  LET node = DOCUMENT(nodeId)
  FILTER node != null AND HAS(node, "label")
  FILTER STARTS_WITH(nodeId, "RTL_Module/")
  LET T = node.valid_from_ts
  FOR mod IN RTL_Module
    FILTER mod.repo == node.repo
    FILTER mod.label != node.label
    FILTER mod.valid_from_ts <= T AND mod.valid_to_ts > T
    LET ep = FIRST(FOR e IN OUTBOUND mod BELONGS_TO_EPOCH SORT ABS(e.start_ts - T) ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN e)
    FILTER ep != null
    FOR ep2, e IN 1..1 OUTBOUND mod BELONGS_TO_EPOCH
      FILTER ep2._id == ep._id
      RETURN e

actions.title: [RTL_Module] Who changed this? (commits + authors)
actions.name: [RTL_Module] Who changed this? (commits + authors)
actions.description: From a module, traverse back through MODIFIED to find the commits, then to the authors who made them.
actions.queryText:
LET edges = (
  FOR n IN @nodes
    LET nodeId = IS_STRING(n) ? n : n._id
    LET node = DOCUMENT(nodeId)
    FILTER node != null
    FILTER STARTS_WITH(nodeId, "RTL_Module/")
    FOR commit, e1 IN 1..1 INBOUND node MODIFIED
      LET author_edges = (FOR author, e2 IN 1..1 INBOUND commit AUTHORED RETURN e2)
      RETURN { mod: e1, auth: author_edges }
)
FOR item IN edges
  FOR e IN APPEND([item.mod], item.auth)
    RETURN e

actions.title: [RTL_Module] What else changed in the same commit
actions.name: [RTL_Module] What else changed in the same commit
actions.description: From a module, find the commits that modified it, then see what other modules were changed in those same commits.
actions.queryText:
FOR n IN @nodes
  LET nodeId = IS_STRING(n) ? n : n._id
  LET node = DOCUMENT(nodeId)
  FILTER node != null
  FILTER STARTS_WITH(nodeId, "RTL_Module/")
  FOR commit IN 1..1 INBOUND node MODIFIED
    FOR sibling, e IN 1..1 OUTBOUND commit MODIFIED
      FILTER sibling._id != node._id
      LIMIT 50
      RETURN e

actions.title: [Author] Show all maintained modules
actions.name: [Author] Show all maintained modules
actions.description: From an Author node, show all modules they maintain (3+ commits, 10%+ contribution).
actions.queryText:
FOR n IN @nodes
  LET nodeId = IS_STRING(n) ? n : n._id
  LET node = DOCUMENT(nodeId)
  FILTER node != null
  FILTER STARTS_WITH(nodeId, "Author/")
  FOR mod, e IN 1..1 OUTBOUND node MAINTAINS
    RETURN e

actions.title: [DesignEpoch] Show epoch timeline (±5 neighbors)
actions.name: [DesignEpoch] Show epoch timeline (±5 neighbors)
actions.description: From an epoch, show the 5 preceding and 5 following epochs in the same repo. Creates a visual timeline.
actions.queryText:
FOR n IN @nodes
  LET nodeId = IS_STRING(n) ? n : n._id
  LET node = DOCUMENT(nodeId)
  FILTER node != null
  FILTER STARTS_WITH(nodeId, "DesignEpoch/")
  LET before = (
    FOR prev, e IN 1..5 INBOUND node PRECEDES_EPOCH
      RETURN e
  )
  LET after = (
    FOR next, e IN 1..5 OUTBOUND node PRECEDES_EPOCH
      RETURN e
  )
  FOR e IN APPEND(before, after)
    RETURN e

actions.title: [DesignEpoch] Jump to milestone releases
actions.name: [DesignEpoch] Jump to milestone releases
actions.description: From any epoch, show all milestone/release epochs in the same repo as a connected timeline.
actions.queryText:
FOR n IN @nodes
  LET nodeId = IS_STRING(n) ? n : n._id
  LET node = DOCUMENT(nodeId)
  FILTER node != null
  FILTER STARTS_WITH(nodeId, "DesignEpoch/")
  FOR m IN DesignEpoch
    FILTER m.repo == node.repo
    FILTER m.epoch_type IN ["milestone_tag", "initial_commit"]
    SORT m.start_ts ASC
    FOR v, e IN 1..1 OUTBOUND m PRECEDES_EPOCH
      FILTER e.edge_type == "milestone_shortcut"
      RETURN e

visualizer_queries.name: [Timeline] MOR1KX Release History (2012→2024)
visualizer_queries.description: Milestone timeline: birth → v1.0 → v5.0 → v5.0-r1 → v5.0-r2 → v5.1 → v5.1.1 → v5.2. Shows time gaps between releases.
visualizer_queries.queryText:
FOR m IN DesignEpoch
  FILTER m.repo == "openrisc/mor1kx.git"
  FILTER m.epoch_type IN ["milestone_tag", "initial_commit"]
  SORT m.start_ts ASC
  FOR v, e, p IN 1..1 OUTBOUND m PRECEDES_EPOCH
    FILTER e.edge_type == "milestone_shortcut"
    RETURN p

visualizer_queries.name: [Timeline] IBEX Release History (2015→2024)
visualizer_queries.description: Milestone timeline for IBEX. Shows the major releases and time gaps between them.
visualizer_queries.queryText:
FOR m IN DesignEpoch
  FILTER m.repo == "lowRISC/ibex.git"
  FILTER m.epoch_type IN ["milestone_tag", "initial_commit"]
  SORT m.start_ts ASC
  FOR v, e, p IN 1..1 OUTBOUND m PRECEDES_EPOCH

visualizer_queries.description: Time travel: IBEX when it was born as a PULP project. Generic names like if_stage, alu, controller. Compare with TT-4.
visualizer_queries.queryText:

  RETURN path

visualizer_queries.name: [TT-4] IBEX rebranded (2019) — 20 ibex_* modules
visualizer_queries.description: Time travel: IBEX after rebranding from zeroriscy. All modules now prefixed ibex_*. Compare with TT-3 to see the naming evolution.
visualizer_queries.queryText:
LET T = 1559347200
FOR mod IN RTL_Module
  FILTER mod.repo == 'lowRISC/ibex.git'
  FILTER mod.valid_from_ts <= T AND mod.valid_to_ts > T
  LET epoch = FIRST(FOR ep IN OUTBOUND mod BELONGS_TO_EPOCH SORT ABS(ep.start_ts - T) ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN ep)
  FILTER epoch != null
  FOR ep2, e, p IN 1..1 OUTBOUND mod BELONGS_TO_EPOCH
    FILTER ep2._id == epoch._id
    RETURN p

visualizer_queries.name: [TT-5] Commit blast — Wishbone refactor (13 modules)
visualizer_queries.description: A single commit that touched 13 modules at once. Shows the blast radius of a Wishbone interface refactor.
visualizer_queries.queryText:
FOR v, e, p IN 1..1 OUTBOUND 'GitCommit/f7f7931b3134e0740237242ff874dfb6820f52b4' MODIFIED
  RETURN p

visualizer_queries.name: [TT-6] Cross-repo bridge — Instruction Fetch
visualizer_queries.description: OR1200 Instruction Fetch Subunit → cross-repo bridges to IBEX, MOR1KX. Shows how a 2001 spec concept survives across 4 repos.
visualizer_queries.queryText:
FOR v, e, p IN 2..3
  ANY 'OR1200_Golden_Entities/OR1200_g_2eeeeaacece8'
  GRAPH 'IC_Temporal_Knowledge_Graph'
  OPTIONS { uniqueVertices: 'path' }
  LET edge_cols = (FOR edge IN p.edges RETURN PARSE_IDENTIFIER(edge._id).collection)
  FILTER 'CROSS_REPO_SIMILAR_TO' IN edge_cols
  LIMIT 25
  RETURN p
